adopt:
# Download Persona from https://github.com/xikhar/persona
# Extract and run it locally on your desktop.
# Then enable persona support in adk:
pip install "awdk"
ADK_PERSONA=1 adk <your-command>

# Or set the env var for all adk sessions:
#   Windows: setx ADK_PERSONA 1
#   Linux:   export ADK_PERSONA=1 >> ~/.bashrc
description:
Kind: pack

What it does
Desktop avatar bridge for Persona. Control a VRM avatar's state, animation, voice, and audio via HTTP loopback — host-run only.

Runtime
awdk>=3.7.0

Tools
  persona_status
  persona_animate
  persona_set_character
  persona_speak_state
  persona_audio_level
  persona_mute_microphone
  persona_mute_output
